transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because I just keep forgetting little things. Stuff I normally handle fine. Like... returning calls, or turning in a registration form. Or even just remembering to stop for an errand on the way home. It just... finally made me think I should ask someone for help.
How long have you been noticing these memory lapses—did they start recently, or have they been going on for months or longer?
Um... I suppose it's been a while. Over a year. Maybe about 15 months ago? I started an evening certificate program back then, and... it just got noticeably harder to manage things after that.
Over these past 15 months, have you also been feeling persistently worried, anxious, sad, or down most days?
No, not really. I mean... I wouldn't say I've felt sad or anything. Just... scattered, I guess. But no, not anxious or down.

Before these last 15 months, would you say you've always had some trouble with attention, organization, or forgetfulness—say, back in school or earlier in your career—or is this a distinctly new change for you?

Um... I guess it's not entirely new. I mean... even back in elementary school, I was always the kid who forgot permission slips. Or... lost my homework in my backpack. My mom and my teachers usually had to remind me, step by step, just to finish projects and things. So... yeah. It's been around.

Right now, would you say these memory and attention slips are causing real problems in more than one area of your life—like at work, at home, and in relationships—or is it mostly noticeable in just one setting?

I suppose... it's mostly work and school. I'm still getting by, for the most part. But... I've missed some small follow-ups at the office, and a few deadlines for my certificate program. It's... well, it happens often enough that I worry. I'd like to move up to an Office Manager position eventually, and... I just don't want this to affect my reputation.
Growing up, did those forgetfulness and organization struggles also cause noticeable problems at home—like with chores, family responsibilities, or relationships—not just at school?
Um... I don't really remember it being a big issue at home. I mean... maybe I forgot a chore here or there, but... nothing that really stands out. It was mostly just school stuff.
Besides forgetting tasks, do you often find your mind wandering or getting easily distracted while you're trying to focus on something, like reading, a conversation, or a work project?

I guess so. Um... if I'm at the office or, you know, in class... it doesn't take much. Just a phone ringing or... people talking nearby. Or sometimes I just start thinking about something I need to do at home, and... I lose my place. So... yeah, I get distracted.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting impulsively—like interrupting others or making quick decisions without thinking them through?

Um... not really impulsive, no. But... I guess I do fidget a little. Like... during those longer classes, I'll notice I'm clicking my pen or... bouncing my foot. Just shifting around in my chair, even when I'm trying to sit still and pay attention. But... that's about it.
Aside from work and school, do these forgetfulness or focus issues also cause problems for you at home—like managing bills, chores, or personal responsibilities?

Um... at home, it's mostly okay. I manage. But... I guess where I notice it most is just... well, at work and with my classes. I'm still getting by, but... I've missed some small follow-ups at the office. And a few deadlines for school. It's not... terrible, but it happens enough that I worry. I just... I don't want it to affect my reputation, you know? Especially since I've been hoping to move up to an Office Manager position eventually. So... yeah, it's mostly work and school where it's a problem.
Do these attention or memory struggles ever cause friction or problems in your friendships or personal relationships—like forgetting plans, losing track of conversations, or missing important dates?
Um... no, not really. I mean... my friends know how I am. I don't really have issues with that kind of stuff. I keep track of plans well enough. So... no, it hasn't been a problem.
